title:
A whole world,
in a single farm.
description: Look a little closer. From the roots beneath your feet to the canopy above, a working farm offers more than a place to stay. It offers a different rhythm.

items.name: Trees to slow down beneath
items.description: Coconut groves, orchards and quiet green corners. Follow a farm walk, or find a little shade of your own.

items.name: Species. A living landscape.
items.description: Different leaves, textures and seasons to notice as you walk. The tree count and diversity are shared by the farm hosts.

items.name: Farm to feel part of
items.description: Meet the animals with your hosts, taste seasonal fruit and reconnect with the everyday life of the land.

heroEveningAlt: A-frame cottages after dark at Aroha
